name: Connector to Interposer Workflow
description: Validate workbook connectivity and reconcile approved connector artifacts in a project copy
description_full: Native KiCad workflow for authoritative workbook import, source-row inspection, copper-layer permissions, independent gang placement, approved read-only connector, interposer, mounting-hole and symbol selection from loaded KiCad libraries, optional RF artifact selection, DXF circle anchors, optional managed board outlines, deterministic schematic and BOM generation, reviewed reconciliation and journal recovery. Isolated native analysis discovers and validates the matching bundled KiCad Python runtime on Windows, Linux and AppImage installations. Applies to a separate controlled project copy. The validated connector profile currently has one signal contact and one ground/shield contact. Footprint and RF authoring remain separate librarian tools. Broader connector profiles, live-editor recovery, generic magnetic picking and fabrication/EM qualification are outside the validated scope.
